programme.desc: A newspaper editor (Jeffrey Lynn) blasts big business, then needs a big-business man's (Donald Crisp) help.
programme.title: Home Town Story

programme.title: Nurse Edith Cavell

programme.title: 49th Parallel

programme.title: Sherlock Holmes in Washington

programme.title: Big Jake

programme.title: North by Northwest

programme.desc: Mr. Dithers leaves Dagwood in charge, ripe for swindlers until Blondie saves the day.

programme.desc: A suave angel (Cary Grant) saves a woman (Loretta Young) and her Episcopal husband (David Niven) from spiritual doubt and marital woe.

programme.title: Once Upon a Time in the West

programme.desc: The arrival of wealthy bachelors in town causes an uproar when families with single daughters aggressively seek engagements, including the Bennet family, with five eligible daughters.
